# Stonkhouse

> Public information about Stock Token options on Robinhood Chain. This is an information site; trades take place in the separate app, where current market availability and quotes are shown.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://stonkhouse.fun/): buyer-first overview, an interactive payoff chart and live contracts when available.
- [How it works](https://stonkhouse.fun/how-it-works): buying, writing, settlement and fees.
- [Risks](https://stonkhouse.fun/risks): what can go wrong for buyers and writers.
- [FAQ](https://stonkhouse.fun/faq): withdrawal times for each vault, and how an option is settled and paid.
- [Legal](https://stonkhouse.fun/legal): availability and instrument facts.
- [Terms](https://stonkhouse.fun/terms) and [Privacy](https://stonkhouse.fun/privacy): current published notices.
- [Protocol documentation](https://docs.stonkhouse.fun/): detailed product and protocol reference.
- [Trading app](https://app.stonkhouse.fun/): live market data, wallet actions and account state.

## Source and interpretation

The site source is the `callhouse-site` repository. In it, `lib/site.ts` holds displayed status and launch fee terms; `lib/live.ts` validates read-only indexer data before showing it. Current fees, quotes, positions and contract addresses are in the app, indexer and verified chain state. No page here asks for a wallet.
